pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-toned regions characterized by sharply defined edges and predominantly straight-line segment boundaries with high pixel contrast against the background network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways with relatively uniform pixel thickness, exhibiting clear junction nodes at intersections of three to four pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line against the background.
